scope: Independent targeted Make preservation repair review

findings.assessment: Minimal removal of old silent rejection rules and diagnostic-aware wrapper with same positive/syntax controls; no hidden default-goal change.
Independent target with clean pinned fmt and explicit revision/compiler; inserted after all to preserve default goal.
Explicit second registration of same source with FFMT_PORTABLE_SHORTEST=1; additional_suites metadata ensures validation rather than relying on a source glob.

Standard-based default capability filter and explicit test-cxx23 target are coherent. Initial coverage concern was a false positive: existing optional=1 marker excludes std23 from coverage. Real Make -n coverage contains no c++23 compile.
